name: Skullsplitter Tusks
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
It's expensive and hard to kill enough tigers to support the export of tiger fangs to the islands in the South Seas. Luckily, we've developed a technique that allows us to take mundane horn-like objects and turn them into undetectable forgeries.

The closest match we've found, amazingly, are the tusks of the Skullsplitter trolls.

Hey, before you say anything, what the buyer doesn't know doesn't hurt them, am I right? Bring me a large number of them so we can get to work on the monthly shipment!
narrative.objectives: Acquire 18 Skullsplitter Tusks and return them to Kebok.
narrative.offerRewardText: Ah, good work, good work! Ugh, though you could have done a better job cleaning off the-- Well, no matter, no matter! My thanks to you, adventurer, our operation will no doubt see increased output and productivity thanks to your help! Good good, now, onto other matters...
narrative.requestItemsText: Tough buggers, aren't they? Well, have you had any luck? Sorry to seem impatient, but this has been a huge thorn in my side! Well?

chain.subtitle: 2 quests from level 35 to 42, 5,500 XP in all.
